objective: Build compounding inbound trust around P2GC's evidence-backed government-market intelligence and convert qualified attention into diagnostic demand and revenue.
rules: Every externally stated fact must be verifiable.
No invented contract values, buyer behavior, opportunity counts, client outcomes, win probabilities, or guarantees.
Methodology and educational posts may publish without client proof when they make no client-outcome claim.
Case-study content requires an APPROVED proof-registry item with public_use APPROVED and documented permission basis.
Modeled ORION recompete signals must never be described as confirmed procurements.
Every content item carries one primary CTA and attribution key.
Revenue and qualified pipeline are the governing performance measures, not vanity engagement.
